title: Our School Garden
grammar: 過去簡單式

blocks.x: Last spring, our class started a small garden behind the school library. At first, nobody was interested. The ground was hard and dry, and there were many rocks in it. Our teacher, Ms. Lin, said, "A garden is like a friend. You have to spend time with it."

Every morning before class, a few of us carried water to the garden. We planted tomatoes, carrots, and some flowers. Jason, the quietest boy in our class, worked harder than anyone. He even brought a book about plants from home.

After two months, the first tomatoes turned red. We were so excited that we took pictures of them. Ms. Lin used them to make a salad, and everyone in the class got a taste. Some students who never ate vegetables asked for more.
Now the garden is the most popular place at our school. Other classes want to join us, too. Jason says he wants to be a farmer in the future. As for me, I learned that good things take time.

questions.question: What is the story mainly about?
options: How a class garden changed the students
How to make a tomato salad
Why Jason wants to be a farmer
Why the school library is popular
questions.explanation: 全文從「一開始沒人有興趣」寫到「每天照顧、收成番茄」，最後菜園成為全校最受歡迎的地方，重點是菜園帶給同學的改變。B、C、D 都只是文中的小細節。

questions.question: What did some students do every morning before class?
options: They read books in the library.
They carried water to the garden.
They made salads for the teacher.
They took pictures of flowers.
questions.explanation: 第二段第一句：“Every morning before class, a few of us carried water to the garden.”

questions.question: What can we learn about Jason?
options: He did not like working in the garden.
He talked the most in class.
He really cared about the garden.
He was Ms. Lin's son.
questions.explanation: 文中說 Jason “worked harder than anyone” 還 “even brought a book about plants from home”，可推知他很用心照顧菜園。

questions.question: In the third paragraph, what does “them” in “Ms. Lin used them to make a salad” mean?
options: The pictures
The students
The flowers
The tomatoes
questions.explanation: 前一句提到 “the first tomatoes turned red”，能拿來做沙拉的是番茄，所以 them = the tomatoes。

title: Why Do Cats Sleep So Much?
grammar: 現在簡單式、頻率副詞

blocks.x: If you have a cat, you may notice that it sleeps most of the day. In fact, cats usually sleep twelve to sixteen hours a day. Some even sleep up to twenty hours. Why do they need so much rest?

The answer goes back to how cats lived in the wild. Wild cats are hunters. To catch food, they must run fast and jump high in a very short time. This uses a lot of energy, so they need to save energy by resting between hunts.

Cats are also most active at dawn and in the evening. That is when many small animals come out, so it is the best time to hunt. During the bright hours of the day, cats often find a warm, quiet corner and take long naps.

However, a sleeping cat is not always deeply asleep. Most of the time, cats are in a light sleep. Their ears may still move when they hear a sound, and they can wake up in a second if there is danger.
So the next time your cat sleeps all afternoon, don't call it lazy. It is just doing what cats have done for thousands of years.

questions.question: What is the reading mainly about?
options: How to take care of a cat
Why cats sleep a lot
What wild cats like to eat
How to wake up a sleeping cat
questions.explanation: 第一段最後一句提出問題 “Why do they need so much rest?”，接下來每一段都在回答這個問題。

questions.question: When are cats most active?
options: At noon
In the afternoon
At dawn and in the evening
In the middle of the night
questions.explanation: 第三段：“Cats are also most active at dawn and in the evening.”

questions.question: What does “nap” mean in the third paragraph?
options: A short sleep
A small animal
A warm place
A fast run
questions.explanation: 貓在白天找個溫暖安靜的角落 “take long naps”，前後文都在講睡覺，可猜出 nap 是「小睡」。

questions.question: In the third paragraph, what does “That” in “That is when many small animals come out” mean?
options: Dawn and the evening
The bright hours of the day
Sixteen hours
A warm, quiet corner
questions.explanation: 前一句說貓在 “at dawn and in the evening” 最活躍，接著說「那正是小動物出來的時候」，That 指的就是黎明和傍晚。

questions.question: Why does the writer say “don't call it lazy”?
options: Because cats only sleep at night
Because sleeping a lot is natural for cats
Because cats never sleep deeply
Because lazy cats are popular
questions.explanation: 最後一句說貓只是在做 “what cats have done for thousands of years”，表示多睡是貓的天性，不是懶。

title: One Umbrella, Two Friends
grammar: 過去簡單式

blocks.x: It was a rainy Monday afternoon. When school was over, I saw a girl standing at the school gate. Her name was Yuting, and she was new in our class. She did not have an umbrella, and she looked very sad.

I had a big blue umbrella, so I walked over to her and said, "We can share it. Where do you live?" She lived near the park, only five minutes from my home. We walked together under my umbrella and talked about music, books, and our favorite food.

The next week, I had a bad cold and stayed home for two days. On Wednesday evening, someone knocked on our door. It was Yuting! She brought me her notes from every class and a bowl of hot soup from her mom. "You helped me in the rain," she said with a smile. "Now it is my turn."
Now Yuting and I are best friends. Every time it rains, we still walk home together under one umbrella.

questions.question: What is the story mainly about?
options: How sharing an umbrella started a friendship
How to stay healthy on rainy days
Why Yuting moved to a new school
What the writer likes to eat
questions.explanation: 故事從雨天和 Yuting 共撐一把傘開始，後來 Yuting 回報作者，最後「Now Yuting and I are best friends.」重點是一把傘帶來的友誼，所以選 A。

questions.question: Why did the writer stay home for two days?
options: Because of the heavy rain
To help Yuting
Because of a bad cold
To look for an umbrella
questions.explanation: 第三段寫「The next week, I had a bad cold and stayed home for two days.」作者是因為感冒才待在家，所以選 C。

questions.question: What does Yuting mean when she says, “Now it is my turn”?
options: She wants to use the umbrella now.
She wants to help the writer this time.
She wants to go home first.
She wants to play a game.
questions.explanation: Yuting 先說「You helped me in the rain」，再說「Now it is my turn.」意思是之前作者幫她，現在換她來幫作者，所以選 B。

questions.question: What did Yuting bring to the writer's home?
options: A blue umbrella and some books
Some music and some food
Some flowers and a card
Her class notes and some soup
questions.explanation: 第三段寫「She brought me her notes from every class and a bowl of hot soup from her mom.」所以選 D。

title: Cooking with Grandma
grammar: 過去簡單式、表示順序的副詞（first、then、next）

blocks.x: Last Sunday, I visited my grandma. She said, "Today, I am going to teach you how to cook tomato eggs." This is my favorite dish, so I was very excited.

First, Grandma showed me how to cut the tomatoes into small pieces. Then I broke three eggs into a bowl and mixed them. She told me to cook the eggs first and take them out of the pan. Next, I cooked the tomatoes with a little sugar and salt. At last, I put the eggs back in and cooked everything for one more minute.

When we tasted it, I made a face. There was too much salt in it! I used a big spoon of salt, not a small one. I felt sad, but Grandma just laughed. She added more tomatoes and a little water, and the dish tasted much better.

"Everyone makes mistakes in the kitchen," she said. "The important thing is to taste your food and fix it." Now I always taste my food before I eat it with my family. I learned more than cooking from Grandma that day.

questions.question: What did the writer do right after breaking the eggs?
options: Cut the tomatoes
Mixed the eggs in a bowl
Added sugar and salt
Took the eggs out of the pan
questions.explanation: 第二段寫「Then I broke three eggs into a bowl and mixed them.」打蛋之後接著就是攪拌，所以選 B。

questions.question: What does “made a face” mean in the story?
options: Drew a picture of a face
Washed the face
Laughed in a happy way
Showed that the food did not taste good
questions.explanation: 「When we tasted it, I made a face. There was too much salt in it!」菜太鹹，作者嚐了之後的反應是「做鬼臉、皺眉」，表示不好吃，所以選 D。

questions.question: Why was there too much salt in the dish at first?
options: Grandma added too much water.
The tomatoes were not fresh.
The writer used a big spoon of salt.
The writer forgot the sugar.
questions.explanation: 第三段寫「I used a big spoon of salt, not a small one.」作者用了大湯匙放鹽，所以太鹹，選 C。加水是奶奶補救的方法。

questions.question: What did the writer learn from Grandma?
options: It is OK to make mistakes, but you should fix them.
Tomato eggs are the easiest dish to cook in the kitchen.
You should always cook with your grandma on Sundays.
Salt is bad for people, so you should not use it.
questions.explanation: 奶奶說「Everyone makes mistakes in the kitchen. The important thing is to taste your food and fix it.」作者也說「I learned more than cooking from Grandma that day.」可知學到的是犯錯沒關係、要想辦法修正，所以選 A。

title: My First Day at a New School
grammar: 過去簡單式、未來式

blocks.x: Last month, my family moved from Tainan to Taichung, so I had to go to a new school. On my first day, I stood in front of Class 7-2, and my hands were cold. I did not know anyone.
"This is Leo," said our teacher, Mr. Wang. "Please make him feel at home." I said hello in a very small voice and sat in the last seat.

At lunch time, I sat by myself. I did not know where to get my lunch box. Then a tall boy came over. "Hi, I am Andy. Come with me," he said. He showed me where to get lunch, and he told me about the school basketball team.
After school, Andy took me around the school. He showed me the library, the gym, and the best place to buy cold drinks. He also asked me to play basketball with him on Friday.
That night, I told my mom, "I was afraid this morning, but now I think I will like this school." I am going to bring my basketball on Friday.

questions.question: Why did Leo go to a new school?
options: He did not like his old school.
He wanted to join a basketball team.
His family moved to a new city.
His teacher told him to.
questions.explanation: 第一段寫「Last month, my family moved from Tainan to Taichung, so I had to go to a new school.」因為搬家所以轉學，選 C。

questions.question: How did Leo feel on the morning of his first day?
options: Afraid
Happy
Angry
Tired
questions.explanation: 文中寫他「my hands were cold」、「I did not know anyone」、說話「in a very small voice」，晚上也說「I was afraid this morning」，可知他早上很害怕、緊張，所以選 A。

questions.question: In “Please make him feel at home,” who does “him” mean?
options: Mr. Wang
Andy
Leo's dad
Leo
questions.explanation: 老師先介紹「This is Leo」，接著說「Please make him feel at home.」請大家讓他有在家的感覺，him 指的是 Leo，所以選 D。

questions.question: What will Leo do on Friday?
options: Visit the library with Andy
Play basketball with Andy
Buy cold drinks for the class
Go back to Tainan
questions.explanation: 第四段寫「He also asked me to play basketball with him on Friday.」最後一句也說「I am going to bring my basketball on Friday.」所以選 B。

title: Bubble Tea: A Drink from Taiwan
zh: 珍珠奶茶：來自台灣的飲料
grammar: 現在簡單式、表示順序的副詞

blocks.x: Bubble tea is a sweet drink from Taiwan. It is usually made with black tea, milk, and sugar. The most special part is the small black balls at the bottom of the cup. People drink them with a big straw.

How do people make bubble tea? First, shop workers cook the balls in hot water for about thirty minutes. Then they put the balls in sugar water to make them sweet. Next, they shake the tea, milk, and ice together. At last, they add the balls to the drink.

Bubble tea started in Taiwan more than thirty years ago. Today, you can find bubble tea shops in many cities around the world, from Tokyo to London. Why do so many people love it? First, it is fun to drink. Second, people can choose the size of the cup and how much sugar and ice they want. Third, many people like to take pictures of their drinks and share them on the Internet.
So the next time you have a cup of bubble tea, remember that people all over the world enjoy this little drink from Taiwan, too.

questions.question: What is the reading mainly about?
options: How to open a bubble tea shop in London
Why drinking tea every day is good for you
Where people can buy the best tea in Taiwan
What bubble tea is and why people love it
questions.explanation: 第一、二段說明珍珠奶茶是什麼、怎麼做，第三段問「Why do so many people love it?」並說明原因，所以選 D。

questions.question: How long do shop workers cook the balls in hot water?
options: About ten minutes
About thirty minutes
About one hour
About three hours
questions.explanation: 第二段寫「First, shop workers cook the balls in hot water for about thirty minutes.」所以選 B。

questions.question: According to the reading, which is NOT a reason why bubble tea is popular?
options: It is cheaper than other drinks.
It is fun to drink.
People can choose how much sugar and ice they want.
People like to take pictures of it.
questions.explanation: 第三段列出三個原因：「it is fun to drink」、可以選大小和甜度冰塊、喜歡拍照分享到網路上。文中沒有提到價格比較便宜，所以選 A。

questions.question: What does “them” in “People drink them with a big straw” mean?
options: The cups
The tea and milk
The small black balls
The people
questions.explanation: 前一句說「the small black balls at the bottom of the cup」，接著說用粗吸管把它們喝起來，them 指的是杯底的黑色小球（珍珠），所以選 C。

title: An E-mail from Kenji
grammar: 現在簡單式、過去簡單式、疑問句

blocks.subject: Summer festival in my town
body: How are you? Thank you for your last e-mail and the photos of the Lantern Festival. They were beautiful!

School in Japan is busy now. My school day starts at 08:30 and ends at 15:30. After class, all the students clean the classrooms together. Then I go to my club. I am in the music club, and I play the drums.

Last Saturday, my town had a summer festival. Many people wore special summer clothes, and there were lots of food stands on the street. At night, there was a big drum show by the river. My little sister ate two bowls of strawberry ice!
Do students in Taiwan clean their classrooms, too? What club are you in? And what is your favorite festival in Taiwan? Please tell me in your next e-mail.

questions.question: What time does Kenji's school day end?
questions.explanation: 信中寫「My school day starts at 08:30 and ends at 15:30.」放學時間是 15:30，所以選 A。08:30 是上學時間。

questions.question: What does “They” in “They were beautiful!” mean?
options: Kenji's classmates
The summer clothes
Mei's photos of the Lantern Festival
The drum show by the river
questions.explanation: 前一句是「Thank you for your last e-mail and the photos of the Lantern Festival.」接著說「They were beautiful!」They 指的是 Mei 寄來的元宵節照片，所以選 C。

questions.question: Why does Kenji write this e-mail?
options: To ask Mei to come to Japan
To tell Mei about his life and ask about hers
To say sorry to Mei
To ask Mei to join his music club
questions.explanation: Kenji 先介紹自己的學校生活和夏日祭典，最後問 Mei「Do students in Taiwan clean their classrooms, too? What club are you in?」等問題，目的是分享自己的生活並詢問對方，所以選 B。

questions.question: What did Kenji's little sister do at the festival?
options: She played the drums.
She wore her school clothes.
She cleaned the classroom.
She ate two bowls of strawberry ice.
questions.explanation: 信中寫「My little sister ate two bowls of strawberry ice!」所以選 D。打鼓的是 Kenji 自己。

title: Not on the List
grammar: 過去簡單式、未來式

blocks.x: Kevin loved basketball. Last month, he wanted to join the school team, so he practiced every day after school. On the big day, Coach Wu watched forty students play. Only twelve of them could join the team.

The next morning, Kevin looked at the list on the wall. His name was not on it. He felt very sad and did not want to talk to anyone at lunch. But that evening, he went to the park and practiced again. "I am not good enough yet," he said to himself, "but I can get better."
One week later, Coach Wu saw Kevin at the park. "You don't give up, do you?" he asked with a smile. "Our team needs someone to keep the score and take care of the balls. Do you want to help us?"
Kevin said yes. Now he goes to every practice. He helps the players, and after practice, they often play with him. Next year, Kevin will try again.

questions.question: What is the story mainly about?
options: A boy who keeps trying after a sad day
A coach who teaches students to play games
A team that wins a big basketball game
A boy who stops playing basketball
questions.explanation: Kevin 沒被選上球隊，但他說 “I am not good enough yet, but I can get better.”，繼續練習，最後以另一種方式加入球隊，故事重點是他不放棄。B、C 文中沒提到；D 與內容相反。

questions.question: How many students could join the school team?
options: Forty
Seven
Twelve
One
questions.explanation: 第一段：“Coach Wu watched forty students play. Only twelve of them could join the team.” 四十人是來參加選拔的人數，能進球隊的只有十二人。

questions.question: What does “give up” mean in “You don't give up, do you?”
options: To give something to a friend
To stop trying
To get up early
To play better than others
questions.explanation: 教練看到 Kevin 沒被選上還在公園練球，才說 “You don't give up, do you?”，可猜出 give up 是「放棄、停止嘗試」。

questions.question: Why did Coach Wu most likely ask Kevin to help the team?
options: Kevin was the best player in the school.
Kevin asked the coach for help.
Kevin's name was on the list.
Kevin kept practicing after he was not chosen.
questions.explanation: 教練在公園看到 Kevin 還在練習，說 “You don't give up, do you?” 之後就請他來幫忙，可見是 Kevin 不放棄的態度打動了教練。A、C 與文意不符；B 文中沒提到。

title: A Birthday Surprise
grammar: 過去簡單式、when 子句

blocks.x: Mr. Chen, our English teacher, is always kind to us. When we learned that his birthday was on Friday, our class decided to give him a surprise.

On Friday morning, Amy brought a big chocolate cake to school. Tom made a card, and everyone wrote something nice on it. Our plan was simple: when Mr. Chen walked into the classroom, we would turn off the lights and sing "Happy Birthday."

We waited quietly in the dark. Then the door opened, and we started to sing. But it was not Mr. Chen. It was Ms. Wang, the school principal! She looked very surprised, and we all stopped singing. Our faces turned red.

Then Ms. Wang laughed. "Mr. Chen is right behind me," she said quietly. "Try again, and I will sing with you." A minute later, Mr. Chen walked in, and the whole class sang to him with the principal. Mr. Chen was so happy that he almost cried. "This is the best birthday ever," he said.

questions.question: Who brought the cake to school?
options: Tom
Amy
Ms. Wang
Mr. Chen
questions.explanation: 第二段：“Amy brought a big chocolate cake to school.” Tom 做的是卡片。

questions.question: In the third paragraph, who does “She” in “She looked very surprised” mean?
options: Amy
A girl in the class
Mr. Chen's mother
Ms. Wang
questions.explanation: 前一句是 “It was Ms. Wang, the school principal!”，走進教室、看到大家唱歌而嚇一跳的是 Ms. Wang。

questions.question: Why did the students' faces turn red?
options: They sang to the wrong person.
The classroom was too hot.
They ate too much cake.
Mr. Chen was angry with them.
questions.explanation: 大家開始唱生日歌，進來的卻是校長 “But it was not Mr. Chen.”，唱錯人所以覺得不好意思，臉都紅了。

questions.question: What is the best title for the story?
options: How to Make a Birthday Card
Our Principal's Birthday
A Surprise That Almost Went Wrong
Why Mr. Chen Was Late
questions.explanation: 同學準備驚喜卻先唱給校長聽，差點搞砸，最後校長幫忙、老師很感動，C 最能代表全文。B：生日的是 Mr. Chen 不是校長；D：文中沒說老師遲到。

title: Smart Ways to Save Pocket Money
grammar: 祈使句、序數詞 first/second/third

blocks.x: Do you get pocket money every week? Many students spend all of it in just a few days. Here are some simple ways to save money.
First, make a plan. Before you spend any money, write down the things you really need, like bus tickets and lunch. Then think about the things you only want, like snacks and drinks.
Second, save first and spend later. When you get your money, put some of it in a box or a bank right away. Don't wait until the end of the week, because there may be nothing left.
Third, wait one day before you buy something. If you still want it the next day, then buy it. You may find that you don't really want it.
Here is an example. Jenny gets $500 every week. She saves $150 and spends the rest. After ten weeks, she has $1,500. Now she can buy the new bike light that she wants.
Saving money is not easy, but small steps can make a big difference.

questions.question: What is the reading mainly about?
options: Why students need pocket money
How Jenny bought a new bike
Simple ways for students to save money
What students like to eat and drink
questions.explanation: 第一段最後說 “Here are some simple ways to save money.”，接著用 First、Second、Third 介紹存錢方法。B：Jenny 要買的是車燈，而且只是例子。

questions.question: How much money does Jenny spend every week?
questions.explanation: “Jenny gets $500 every week. She saves $150 and spends the rest.” 每週花掉的是 500 − 150 = $350。$1,500 是十週存下的錢。

questions.question: What should you do when you get your pocket money?
options: Spend it all on snacks.
Wait until the end of the week.
Give it to your parents.
Put some of it away at once.
questions.explanation: 第三段：“When you get your money, put some of it in a box or a bank right away. Don't wait until the end of the week.”

questions.question: What does “the rest” mean in “She saves $150 and spends the rest”?
options: The money that is left
A short time to sleep
The money in the bank
All the money she has
questions.explanation: Jenny 有 $500，先存 $150，再把「剩下的」花掉，所以 the rest 指剩下的錢。B 是 rest「休息」的另一個意思，不合句意。

title: Colors and Feelings
grammar: 現在簡單式、make + 人 + 形容詞

blocks.x: Colors are all around us, and they can change the way we feel.
Red is a strong color. It can make people feel excited or even hungry. That is why many restaurants use red in their signs and advertisements.
Blue is a quiet color. It often makes people feel calm. Many people paint their bedrooms blue because it helps them sleep well.
Yellow is bright and happy, like the sun. A yellow kitchen or a yellow T-shirt can make you feel warm and happy. But too much yellow may make some people feel nervous.
Green is the color of trees and grass. It makes people think of nature, so many hospitals and schools use green to help people feel safe.
The next time you choose your clothes or paint your room, think about the colors. They may say more than you think!

questions.question: Which color can make people feel hungry?
options: Blue
Green
Yellow
Red
questions.explanation: 第二段：“Red ... can make people feel excited or even hungry.” 所以很多餐廳的招牌用紅色。

questions.question: Lucy wants her bedroom to be a calm place to sleep. Which color is best for her room?
options: Blue
Red
Yellow
Black
questions.explanation: 第三段：藍色 “often makes people feel calm. Many people paint their bedrooms blue because it helps them sleep well.” 紅色讓人興奮，太多黃色可能讓人緊張。

questions.question: What is the main idea of the reading?
options: Red is the most popular color.
Hospitals should use green.
Colors can change how people feel.
Yellow is not a good color.
questions.explanation: 第一段 “Colors ... can change the way we feel.” 是全文主旨，後面各段介紹不同顏色帶來的感覺。A、B、D 都只是部分內容或文中沒說的。

questions.question: In the last paragraph, what does “They” in “They may say more than you think” mean?
options: Your clothes
The colors
People
Your rooms
questions.explanation: 前一句是 “think about the colors”，接著說 “They may say more than you think”，They 指的是顏色，意思是顏色傳達的訊息比你想的多。

title: The Dragon Boat Festival
grammar: 現在簡單式、過去簡單式

blocks.x: The date of the Dragon Boat Festival follows the old Chinese calendar, so it changes every year. It usually comes in May or June. It is one of the most important holidays in Taiwan.

The festival is about a man called Qu Yuan. Long ago, he was a good officer who loved his country very much. But the king did not listen to him. Qu Yuan was so sad that he jumped into a river and died. People loved him, so they went out in boats to look for him. They also threw rice into the river so that the fish would not eat his body.

Today, people in Taiwan remember him in many ways. Families eat rice dumplings. These are made of rice, meat, and eggs inside large leaves. Teams race long boats with dragon heads on rivers. The people in each boat move together to the sound of a drum.
Some families also hang plants on their doors to keep bad things away. And some people try to stand an egg up at noon. They believe it will make them lucky.

questions.question: When does the Dragon Boat Festival usually come?
options: In January or February
In May or June
In September
In the winter
questions.explanation: 第一段：“It usually comes in May or June.” 端午節依照農曆，日期每年不同，通常在五月或六月。

questions.question: Why did people throw rice into the river?
options: To feed the dragons in the river
To make the king happy
To keep bad things away
So the fish would not eat Qu Yuan's body
questions.explanation: 第二段：“They also threw rice into the river so that the fish would not eat his body.” C 是掛植物在門上的原因。

questions.question: What does “race” mean in “Teams race long boats with dragon heads”?
options: To try to be faster than others
To make something with your hands
To sell something at a market
To clean something with water
questions.explanation: 很多隊伍划著龍舟、跟著鼓聲一起前進，就是在「比賽速度」，所以 race 是「比快、競賽」。

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT talked about in the reading?
options: Eating rice dumplings
Hanging plants on doors
Giving red envelopes
Standing an egg up at noon
questions.explanation: 文中提到吃粽子（rice dumplings）、划龍舟、在門上掛植物、中午立蛋，沒有提到發紅包（red envelopes）。

title: Where Should We Go?
grammar: 未來式、How about／we can 提議

lines.x: Hi, everyone! We have no class this Saturday. Where should we go?
How about the zoo? I want to see the baby panda.
The zoo is fun, but it is far. It takes an hour by train, and the ticket is $60.
What about the science museum? It is only $30 for students.
Sorry, the museum is closed this Saturday. My brother told me.
Then we can go to the beach! It is free, and the bus only takes 40 minutes.
Good idea, but the weather report says it will rain all day on Saturday.
Then why don't we go on Sunday? It will be sunny.
OK! But I have a piano lesson at 15:00 on Sunday.
No problem. We can meet at the bus stop at 08:30 and come back at 13:00.
Great! Don't forget your hats and water.
See you on Sunday!

questions.question: Where will the friends go?
options: To the zoo
To the science museum
To the beach
To a piano lesson
questions.explanation: Amy 提議 “we can go to the beach!”，因為週六會下雨，大家改成週日去，最後約在公車站集合。動物園太遠、博物館週六沒開。

questions.question: Why don't the friends go to the science museum?
options: It is not open on Saturday.
It is too far away.
The tickets cost too much.
It will rain all day.
questions.explanation: Ben 說 “the museum is closed this Saturday.” B、C 是 Kelly 對動物園的說法；D 是天氣，跟博物館無關。

questions.question: When will the friends meet?
options: On Saturday at 08:30
On Sunday at 13:00
On Sunday at 15:00
On Sunday at 08:30
questions.explanation: Amy 說 “We can meet at the bus stop at 08:30”，而且大家改成週日去。13:00 是回來的時間，15:00 是 Ben 的鋼琴課。

questions.question: What does “It” in Amy's line “It is free” mean?
options: The bus
The beach
The weather
The zoo ticket
questions.explanation: Amy 說 “we can go to the beach! It is free”，It 指海邊（the beach），不用花錢。公車還要坐 40 分鐘，並沒有說免費。

title: Library Notice
grammar: 被動語態、if 子句、情態助動詞 can／must

blocks.title: Sunshine Junior High School Library
items: Students in Grade 7 and Grade 8 can borrow up to 3 books at a time. Students in Grade 9 can borrow up to 5 books because they need more books to get ready for the exam.
Books can be kept for 14 days. If you need a book for a longer time, ask at the front desk. You can keep it for 7 more days, but only once.
Magazines and dictionaries must stay in the library. They may not be taken home.
If a book is returned late, you must pay $5 a day for each book.
If you lose a book, you will have to buy a new one for the library.
Please keep quiet. Food and drinks are not allowed, but you may bring water.
blocks.foot: Thank you for helping us keep the library a great place to read!

questions.question: On which day does the library close the latest?
options: Monday
Wednesday
Friday
Saturday
questions.explanation: 表格：週一、二、四開到 17:30，週三只到 12:00，週五到 16:30，週末不開，所以最晚關門的是 Monday。

questions.question: Tom returned 2 books 4 days late. How much did he have to pay?
questions.explanation: “you must pay $5 a day for each book.” 2 本書 × 4 天 × $5 = $40。$20 是只算一本書的錢。

questions.question: Lisa is in Grade 9. How many books can she borrow at a time?
questions.explanation: “Students in Grade 9 can borrow up to 5 books.” 3 本是七、八年級的上限；7 和 14 是天數。

questions.question: Which of the following is TRUE about the library?
options: Students can take dictionaries home for a week.
Students can keep a book for 28 days in all.
Students can drink water in the library.
Students can study there on Wednesday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 公告寫 “Food and drinks are not allowed, but you may bring water.” 所以可以喝水。A：字典不能帶回家；B：最多 14 + 7 = 21 天；D：週三只開到 12:00。

questions.question: Why was this notice written?
options: To tell students how to use the library
To ask students to buy new books
To tell students about the exam
To ask students to work in the library
questions.explanation: 公告列出開放時間、借書本數、借期、逾期罰款和館內規定，目的是告訴學生如何使用圖書館。

title: Summer Camps for Kids and Teens
grammar: 比較級、if 子句、被動語態

blocks.title: Green Hill Summer Camps
blocks.sub: Have fun, make friends, and learn something new this summer!
items: All camps are held from Monday to Friday, 09:00–16:00. Lunch is free.
Early Bird: Sign up before May 31 and pay $200 less for each camp.
Two Camps: If you join two camps, you get $500 off the cheaper one.
Both discounts can be used together.
Bring a water bottle and a hat every day.
blocks.foot: Sign up at our front desk or call 2555-0815.

questions.question: Mia is 14. She is only free in the last two weeks of July. Which camp can she join?
options: Basketball Camp
Mountain Hiking Camp
Art and Music Camp
Science Camp
questions.explanation: 七月最後兩週的營隊是 Art and Music Camp（7/19–23）和 Mountain Hiking Camp（7/26–30）。藝術音樂營只收 8–12 歲，14 歲的 Mia 只能參加 13–16 歲的登山營。

questions.question: Eric is 12. On June 10, he signs up for Basketball Camp and Science Camp. How much does he pay?
questions.explanation: 6 月 10 日報名，已過 5 月 31 日，沒有早鳥優惠。參加兩個營隊，較便宜的籃球營折 $500：3,000 + 3,500 − 500 = $6,000。

questions.question: Amy is 9. She signs up for Art and Music Camp on May 20. How much does she pay?
questions.explanation: 9 歲只能參加 Art and Music Camp，原價 $2,800。5 月 31 日前報名可少付 $200：2,800 − 200 = $2,600。只參加一個營隊，沒有兩營折扣。

questions.question: What should students at the camps bring every day?
options: Their lunch
A ball and a hat
Some money for lunch
A water bottle and a hat
questions.explanation: 廣告最後一點：“Bring a water bottle and a hat every day.” 午餐是免費的（Lunch is free），不用自己帶或付錢。

questions.question: Who can NOT join any of the camps?
options: A girl who is 9
A girl who is 7
A boy who is 15
A boy who is 11
questions.explanation: 營隊年齡最小是 Art and Music Camp 的 8 歲，所以 7 歲的女孩都不能參加。9 歲、11 歲可參加藝術音樂營；15 歲可參加科學營或登山營。

title: Flu Shots at the Health Center
grammar: 被動語態、if 子句、現在完成式

blocks.title: Sunny Hill Health Center
blocks.sub: Opening Hours and Flu Shot Information
items: The flu shot is given from October 15 to November 30, in the morning and afternoon only. It is not given in the evening.
Children under 13 and people who are 65 or older can get a flu shot for free. Other people pay $350.
Please bring your health card. Children must come with a parent.
If you have a fever on that day, do not get a shot. Come back when you feel better.
After the shot, your arm may be sore for a day or two. This is common and nothing to worry about.
To stay healthy this winter, wash your hands often, wear a mask when you are sick, and get enough sleep.
blocks.foot: Many people have already signed up, so please call 2777-1234 before you come.

questions.question: Mr. Lin works from 08:00 to 18:00 on weekdays. When can he get a flu shot?
options: On Monday at 19:00
On Friday at 20:00
On Sunday at 10:00
On Saturday at 15:00
questions.explanation: 流感疫苗 “in the morning and afternoon only”，晚上不打，所以 A、B 不行；週日不開。週六下午 14:30–17:30 有開，15:00 可以去。

questions.question: Grandma is 70, her grandson is 8, and his mother is 40. They all get flu shots. How much do they pay in all?
questions.explanation: “Children under 13 and people who are 65 or older can get a flu shot for free. Other people pay $350.” 70 歲的奶奶和 8 歲的孫子免費，只有 40 歲的媽媽要付 $350。

questions.question: What should people bring when they get a flu shot?
options: Their health card
A mask
Some medicine
A letter from school
questions.explanation: 公告：“Please bring your health card.” 口罩是生病時要戴的保健建議，不是打疫苗要帶的東西。

questions.question: Who should NOT get a flu shot today?
options: A boy who has come with his father
A woman who has a fever today
A man who is 66 years old
A girl who has her health card
questions.explanation: “If you have a fever on that day, do not get a shot. Come back when you feel better.” 今天發燒的人不該打。

questions.question: What does “sore” mean in “your arm may be sore for a day or two”?
options: Strong
Clean
Hurting a little
Too cold
questions.explanation: 打針之後手臂一兩天會這樣，而且公告說 “nothing to worry about”，可猜出 sore 是「痠痛」。

title: Our Recycling Guide
grammar: 被動語態、祈使句、so that

blocks.title: Rainbow Building Recycling Guide
blocks.sub: Let us keep our home clean and green!
rows: Plastic bottles, cans, and old clothes
items: The recycling truck comes at 19:30 and stays for only 15 minutes. Please bring your things to the front gate on time.
Wash bottles and cans before you recycle them, and take off the caps.
Fold paper boxes so that they take up less space.
Old clothes must be clean and put in a bag.
Old phones and batteries are not taken by the truck. Put them in the red box next to the building office.
Anyone who leaves trash in the recycling area will have to pay $1,200.
blocks.foot: Thank you for helping to make our building a better place to live.

questions.question: Mrs. Chen has some empty glass bottles. On which day can she recycle them?
options: Tuesday
Thursday
Saturday
Monday
questions.explanation: 表格：Thursday 回收 “Glass bottles”。週二、週六收的是塑膠瓶和鐵鋁罐，不是玻璃瓶。

questions.question: Where should people put their old phones?
options: In the red box next to the office
In a bag at the front gate
On the recycling truck
In the recycling area
questions.explanation: “Old phones and batteries are not taken by the truck. Put them in the red box next to the building office.”

questions.question: On Tuesday, Kevin brings some cans to the front gate at 19:50. What will most likely happen?
options: He can give the cans to the truck.
He has to pay $1,200.
The truck has already left.
He has to wait until Wednesday.
questions.explanation: 回收車 19:30 來、只停 15 分鐘，也就是 19:45 就走了，19:50 才到一定趕不上。D：週三沒有回收，下一次收罐子是週六。

questions.question: How many days a week can people recycle paper?
options: One
Three
Five
Two
questions.explanation: 表格中回收 “Paper and boxes” 的是 Monday 和 Friday，一週兩天。

questions.question: What does “fold” mean in “Fold paper boxes so that they take up less space”?
options: To wash something with water
To throw something away
To put something in a bag
To make something smaller
questions.explanation: 做這個動作是為了讓紙箱 “take up less space”（佔比較少空間），可猜出 fold 是「摺疊、壓平」。

title: The Lion and the Mouse
grammar: 過去式、關係子句、被動語態、if 條件句

blocks.x: Once upon a time, a big lion was sleeping under a tree in the forest. A little mouse, who was looking for food, ran across the face of the sleeping lion by mistake. The lion woke up angry and caught the mouse with his big foot.

"Please let me go," cried the mouse. "If you do, I will help you one day." The lion laughed. "How can a tiny animal like you ever help the king of the forest?" But he thought the mouse was funny, so he lifted his foot and let it go.
A few days later, the lion was caught in a net that some hunters had left on the ground. The more he moved, the harder it was to get out. He cried out so loudly that the whole forest could hear him.

The little mouse heard the sound and knew it was the lion. It ran to him at once and began to bite the ropes of the net with its sharp teeth. After a long time, one rope broke, and then another. Soon the lion was free.
"You laughed at me," said the mouse, "but now you see that even a small friend can be a great help." The lion thanked the mouse, and from that day on, they were good friends.
The lesson of this story is clear: we should be kind to everyone, because nobody is too small to help others. Never decide how important someone is by their size.

questions.question: What is the lesson of the story?
options: Even small ones can help others.
Strong animals should be the kings of the forest.
We should never sleep under a tree in the forest.
Hunters are very dangerous to all animals.
questions.explanation: 最後一段直接說出寓意：「we should be kind to everyone, because nobody is too small to help others.」小老鼠也能救獅子，所以選 A。B、C、D 都不是故事要說的道理。

questions.question: Why did the lion catch the mouse?
options: He wanted to eat the little mouse for lunch.
The mouse took his food.
The mouse ran across his face and woke him up.
The mouse laughed at him while he was sleeping.
questions.explanation: 第一段：「A little mouse … ran across the face of the sleeping lion by mistake. The lion woke up angry and caught the mouse」老鼠跑過獅子的臉把牠吵醒，所以選 C。文中沒有說獅子想吃牠；嘲笑別人的是獅子，不是老鼠。

questions.question: In the second paragraph, what does “it” in “he lifted his foot and let it go” mean?
options: The forest
The net
His foot
The mouse
questions.explanation: 前面提到獅子覺得老鼠很好笑（he thought the mouse was funny），所以抬起腳「放牠走」，it 指的是老鼠。

questions.question: Why did the lion laugh when the mouse said, “I will help you one day”?
options: He thought the mouse was telling a funny story about the forest.
He did not believe a tiny animal could help him.
He was happy because he was free from the net.
He wanted to play a game with the mouse.
questions.explanation: 獅子笑著說：「How can a tiny animal like you ever help the king of the forest?」可知牠不相信這麼小的動物能幫上忙，所以選 B。這時獅子還沒被網子困住，C 時間不對。

questions.question: What does “free” mean in “Soon the lion was free”?
options: No longer caught
Not costing any money
Very hungry
Not busy
questions.explanation: 前一句說老鼠把網子的繩子一條條咬斷（one rope broke, and then another），所以獅子「脫困、不再被困住」。free 雖然也有「免費」、「有空」的意思，但在這裡不合文意。

title: A Different Typhoon Day Off
grammar: 過去式、關係子句、現在完成式、最高級

blocks.x: Last September, a strong typhoon was coming to Taiwan. That evening, the news said that schools and offices in our city would be closed the next day. I jumped up and shouted, "Typhoon day off!" I planned to sleep late, play video games, and eat noodles all day.

The next morning, the wind was so strong that the trees outside were shaking. Heavy rain hit the windows. Then, at around 10:00, the lights went out. Without power, my games did not work, and I soon felt bored.

My mother looked out the window and said, "I am worried about Mrs. Chen." Mrs. Chen is an old woman who lives alone on the first floor of our building. Her children work in Taipei, and she does not walk well. Mom asked me to go with her to check on Mrs. Chen.

When we knocked on her door, Mrs. Chen was sitting in the dark. Some water had come in under her door. We helped her clean the floor and brought her some candles, bread, and water. Later, Mom cooked hot soup, and I carried a bowl downstairs to her.

Mrs. Chen held my hand and said, "You are a good boy. Thank you for remembering me." Her words made me feel warmer than the soup. I have had many typhoon days off, but this one was the most special. I learned that a day off is not only a time to rest. It can also be a time to care for others.

questions.question: What is the story mainly about?
options: Why typhoons are dangerous in Taiwan
How to cook hot soup when there is no power at home
How a typhoon day off became special for the writer
Why Mrs. Chen's children live in Taipei
questions.explanation: 故事從作者本來只想在家玩，寫到去幫陳奶奶，最後說「this one was the most special」，重點是這個颱風假為什麼特別，所以選 C。

questions.question: What did the writer first plan to do on the day off?
options: Sleep late and play video games
Visit Mrs. Chen with his mother
Help his mother clean the house
Take a trip to Taipei
questions.explanation: 第一段：「I planned to sleep late, play video games, and eat noodles all day.」去看陳奶奶是停電後媽媽提議的，不是原本的計畫。

questions.question: Why was Mom worried about Mrs. Chen?
options: She often forgets to close her windows.
Her children were coming to visit her.
Her house is far away from the city.
She lives alone and does not walk well.
questions.explanation: 第三段：「Mrs. Chen is an old woman who lives alone … and she does not walk well.」颱風天一個行動不便的老人獨自在家，所以媽媽擔心她。她的孩子在台北工作，並沒有要來看她。

questions.question: What does “check on” mean in the third paragraph?
options: To pay money for something
To go and see if someone is OK
To write someone's name on a list
To tell someone to leave
questions.explanation: 媽媽擔心陳奶奶，所以帶作者去「check on」她，接著他們去敲門、幫忙清理。可知意思是「去看看某人是否安好」。

questions.question: What did the writer carry downstairs after Mom cooked?
options: Some bread and water
Some video games
A bowl of hot soup
A box of noodles
questions.explanation: 第四段：「Later, Mom cooked hot soup, and I carried a bowl downstairs to her.」麵包和水是一開始就帶去的，不是煮完之後拿下去的。

title: Grandpa's Old Photo
grammar: 過去進行式、比較級、現在完成式、because/since

blocks.x: Last Sunday, while I was helping Grandpa clean his room, I found a box under his bed. Inside it was an old photo in black and white. In the photo, about forty children were standing in front of a small old building. Most of them had nothing on their feet.

"That is my school," Grandpa said with a smile. "The boy in the second row is me. I was ten years old then." I could hardly believe it. The thin boy in the photo looked nothing like the grandpa I know.

Grandpa told me that his family lived in a small village in Chiayi. Every morning he walked for an hour to get to school. Since his family was poor, he had only one pair of shoes, so he wore them only on special days. On other days, he walked to school without shoes.

His classroom had no fans, and there were not enough books. Two students had to share one book. After school, Grandpa helped his parents on the farm until it got dark. "We were tired, but we were happy," he said. "We played games with stones, and we did not need anything else."

Compared with the school in the photo, mine is much more comfortable. We have cool classrooms, computers, and a big library. However, I sometimes complain about homework. After hearing his story, I have decided to stop complaining and enjoy what I have. I asked Grandpa if I could keep a copy of the photo, and now it sits on my desk.

questions.question: What is the story mainly about?
options: How to clean an old room
What the writer learned from Grandpa's old photo
Why Grandpa moved away from Chiayi
How children played games with stones long ago
questions.explanation: 全文從找到照片、聽爺爺說以前上學的故事，到最後「I have decided to stop complaining and enjoy what I have」，重點是作者從老照片學到的事，所以選 B。

questions.question: Which is TRUE about Grandpa's school days?
options: His school was very close to his house.
He wore shoes to school every day.
His classroom had many computers.
Two students had to share one book.
questions.explanation: 第四段：「Two students had to share one book.」其他選項：他每天要走一小時才到學校；平常不穿鞋；有電腦的是作者的學校。

questions.question: Why did Grandpa wear his shoes only on special days?
options: He had only one pair and wanted to keep them nice.
His teacher did not let students wear shoes.
The shoes were too small for his feet.
He liked how the warm ground felt under his feet.
questions.explanation: 第三段：「Since his family was poor, he had only one pair of shoes, so he wore them only on special days.」家裡窮、只有一雙鞋，所以捨不得天天穿，選 A。

questions.question: In the last paragraph, what does “mine” in “mine is much more comfortable” mean?
options: Grandpa's school
The writer's bedroom
The writer's school
The writer's photo
questions.explanation: 「Compared with the school in the photo, mine is much more comfortable.」拿來和照片裡爺爺的學校比較的是作者自己的學校，mine = my school。

questions.question: How did the writer change after hearing Grandpa's story?
options: The writer wanted to move to a village.
The writer decided to enjoy what the writer already has.
The writer stopped doing homework.
The writer put the old photo back in the box.
questions.explanation: 最後一段：「After hearing his story, I have decided to stop complaining and enjoy what I have.」照片的複本現在放在書桌上，並沒有收回盒子裡。

title: Our Beach Cleanup Day
grammar: 過去完成式、關係子句、被動語態、現在完成式、if 條件句

blocks.x: Last month, our class took part in a beach cleaning day in Taitung. I thought it would be an easy and fun trip. When we got off the bus, the beach looked beautiful from far away. But when we walked closer, we saw that the sand was covered with trash.
Our teacher, Mr. Huang, gave each of us a pair of gloves and a big bag. "Pick up everything that does not belong here," he said. We worked in groups for three hours under the hot sun.

We found many things that people had left behind or thrown into the sea. There were plastic bottles, straws, food boxes, and fishing nets. My group even found an old shoe. Altogether, our class collected more than fifty bags of trash. A worker told us that most of it was plastic, which can stay in the ocean for hundreds of years.

The thing that surprised me most was a small sea turtle that was caught in a piece of fishing net. Mr. Huang and the worker carefully cut the net and let the turtle go back into the water. We all cheered, but I also felt sad. Who knows how many other animals are hurt by our trash?

Since that day, I have changed some of my habits. I bring my own water bottle and never use plastic straws now. When I buy drinks, I say no to plastic bags. These are small changes, but if everyone does a little, our beaches will be cleaner.

questions.question: What is the story mainly about?
options: Why Taitung is a good place to swim in summer
How to catch sea turtles
What Mr. Huang teaches in class
How a beach cleaning day changed the writer
questions.explanation: 文章寫淨灘的經過、看到被漁網纏住的海龜，最後一段說「Since that day, I have changed some of my habits.」重點是這次淨灘如何改變作者，所以選 D。

questions.question: Before the trip, what did the writer think it would be like?
options: Long and boring
Easy and fun
Hot and hard
Sad and dangerous
questions.explanation: 第一段：「I thought it would be an easy and fun trip.」在大太陽下工作三小時、看到海龜而難過，都是到了海灘之後的事。

questions.question: What does “Altogether” mean in the third paragraph?
options: Very quickly
One by one, very slowly
When all are added together
Without any help
questions.explanation: 「Altogether, our class collected more than fifty bags of trash.」前面列出各組撿到的東西，這句說全班「總共」撿了五十多袋，所以是「全部加起來」。

questions.question: Why did the writer feel sad after the turtle was saved?
options: Many other animals may also be hurt by trash.
The turtle swam away too fast.
The worker cut the net in the wrong way and hurt it.
The class had to go home early.
questions.explanation: 第四段最後一句：「Who knows how many other animals are hurt by our trash?」作者想到還有許多動物可能被垃圾傷害，所以難過。

questions.question: Which is one of the writer's new habits?
options: Cleaning the beach every week
Buying drinks in plastic cups
Going to the beach in Taitung every month
Bringing a water bottle from home
questions.explanation: 最後一段：「I bring my own water bottle and never use plastic straws now.」文中沒有說每週淨灘或每月去台東；作者是拒用塑膠袋，不會用塑膠杯買飲料。

title: Why Teens Need Enough Sleep
zh: 青少年為什麼需要充足睡眠
grammar: 比較級、被動語態、when/if 子句、不定詞與動名詞

blocks.x: Many students in Taiwan go to bed late. They study until midnight, finish homework after their extra classes, or play on their phones in bed. The next morning, they can hardly get out of bed, and some even fall asleep in class. Does this sound like you?

Doctors say that teenagers need more sleep than adults, usually about eight to ten hours a night. This is because their bodies and brains are still growing. While we are sleeping, the body rests and gets stronger, and the brain stores what we have learned during the day. In other words, sleep helps us remember things better.

When teens do not get enough sleep, many problems can appear. They may find it hard to pay attention in class, and their grades may drop. They are also more likely to get sick, feel angry, or have accidents. Some people even eat more junk food when they are tired.

So how can you sleep better? First, try to go to bed and get up at the same time every day, even on weekends. Second, put your phone away at least one hour before bed, because the light from the screen can make it hard to fall asleep. Third, do not drink coffee or tea in the evening. Finally, if you have a lot of homework, plan your time well so that you do not have to stay up late.
Sleep is not a waste of time. It is one of the best things you can do for your health and your grades.

questions.question: What is the reading mainly about?
options: Why teens need enough sleep and how to sleep better
Why students should study late before tests
How doctors help people who do not sleep well
What kinds of food are good for teenagers
questions.explanation: 第二、三段說明青少年為什麼需要睡眠、睡不夠會怎樣，第四段給睡得更好的方法，所以選 A。

questions.question: Why do teenagers need more sleep than adults?
options: They have much more homework than adults.
They play on their phones too much.
Their bodies and brains are still growing.
They eat more junk food than adults.
questions.explanation: 第二段：「This is because their bodies and brains are still growing.」A、B、D 都不是文中說的原因。

questions.question: What does “stay up” mean in the fourth paragraph?
options: To get up early
To not go to bed
To stand up in class
To climb to a high place
questions.explanation: 「plan your time well so that you do not have to stay up late」整段都在講早點睡，好好安排時間就不必「熬夜、很晚不睡」，所以選 B。

questions.question: Which is NOT a tip in the reading?
options: Go to bed at the same time every day.
Put your phone away before bed.
Plan your homework time well.
Drink a cup of tea after dinner.
questions.explanation: 第四段說：「do not drink coffee or tea in the evening」晚上不要喝茶或咖啡，所以 D 不是文中的建議。A、B、C 都是第四段提到的方法。

questions.question: Why does the writer ask “Does this sound like you?” in the first paragraph?
options: To make students think about their own sleep
To tell a funny story about a student
To show that the writer often sleeps late
To ask students to write a letter to the writer
questions.explanation: 第一段描述很多學生晚睡、早上爬不起來，再問讀者「這像不像你？」，目的是讓讀者想想自己的睡眠習慣，引出後面的說明。

title: Why Bees Matter
grammar: 現在完成進行式、被動語態、關係子句、比較級、if 條件句

blocks.x: When you think of bees, you may think of honey, or you may feel a little afraid. But bees do much more than make honey. In fact, without bees, many of the fruits and vegetables that we eat every day would be hard to find.

Bees fly from flower to flower to collect food. As they move, they carry a yellow powder from one flower to another. This helps plants make seeds and fruit. Apples, watermelons, and many other foods depend on this work. Farmers who grow these foods need bees as much as they need rain and sun.

Sadly, the number of bees has been falling in many parts of the world. There are several reasons. First, many farms and forests have been turned into roads and buildings, so bees have fewer places to live and find food. Second, some poisons that farmers use to kill insects can also hurt bees. Third, changes in the weather make it harder for flowers to open at the right time.

The good news is that everyone can help. You can plant flowers at home or in your school garden. You can buy honey from farmers near you who keep bees in safe ways. Most of all, if you see a bee, do not try to kill it. Just walk away slowly. Bees are small, but our world really needs them.

questions.question: What is the reading mainly about?
options: How to make honey at home
Why bees are important and how to protect them
Why people are afraid of bees
How to plant flowers in your school garden
questions.explanation: 第二段說明蜜蜂幫植物結果，第三段說明蜜蜂為何減少，第四段說人人可以怎麼幫忙，所以選 B。

questions.question: How do bees help plants?
options: They eat the small insects on the plants.
They give water to flowers.
They keep the plants warm.
They carry a yellow powder from flower to flower.
questions.explanation: 第二段：「they carry a yellow powder from one flower to another. This helps plants make seeds and fruit.」

questions.question: Which is NOT a reason why there are fewer bees?
options: There are fewer places for bees to live.
Some poisons used by farmers hurt bees.
People eat too much honey.
Changes in the weather affect flowers.
questions.explanation: 第三段列出三個原因：棲地變成道路建築、農藥傷害蜜蜂、天氣改變影響花開。文中沒有提到人們吃太多蜂蜜，所以選 C。

questions.question: In the last sentence, what does “them” in “our world really needs them” mean?
options: Bees
Flowers
Farmers
Ways
questions.explanation: 「Bees are small, but our world really needs them.」同一句前半講的是蜜蜂，them 指的就是 bees。

questions.question: What would most likely happen if there were no bees?
options: People would have more honey to eat.
Some fruits would be harder to find.
There would be more flowers in gardens.
Farmers would not need any rain.
questions.explanation: 第一段：「without bees, many of the fruits and vegetables that we eat every day would be hard to find.」沒有蜜蜂，很多水果會變少，所以選 B。

title: Plastic in the Ocean
grammar: 被動語態、關係子句、現在簡單式、祈使句

blocks.x: The ocean covers most of the Earth, and it is home to millions of animals. However, every year, a large amount of plastic ends up in the sea. How does it get there, and why is it a problem?

Plastic gets into the ocean in many ways. Some is left on beaches by visitors. Some is thrown on the streets, and then rain washes it into rivers, which carry it to the sea. Even plastic in trash cans can be blown away by strong winds. Once it is in the water, it can travel thousands of kilometers.

Plastic is dangerous to sea animals. Sea turtles often eat plastic bags because the bags look like their favorite food. Sea birds may feed small pieces of plastic to their babies. Fish and other animals can get caught in old fishing nets and die. Plastic does not go away quickly. It slowly breaks into tiny pieces, which are eaten by small fish. Later, those fish may be eaten by bigger fish, and even by people.

Students can help, too. Bring your own cup and bottle, and do not buy drinks in plastic cups or bottles. Say no to straws and plastic bags. Never leave trash on the beach, and join a beach cleaning day if you can. When you see plastic on the street, pick it up and put it in the right trash can. Small actions like these can keep plastic out of the ocean.

questions.question: What is the reading mainly about?
options: Why people should eat more fish from the sea
Where sea turtles like to live
How plastic gets into the sea and hurts animals
How bottles are made from plastic
questions.explanation: 第一段提出問題「How does it get there, and why is it a problem?」，第二段回答塑膠怎麼進入海洋，第三段說明對海洋動物的傷害，所以選 C。

questions.question: How can plastic on the street get into the sea?
options: It is carried by rain and rivers.
Visitors throw it from their boats.
Sea birds carry it there.
Fish take it into the water.
questions.explanation: 第二段：「Some is thrown on the streets, and then rain washes it into rivers, which carry it to the sea.」

questions.question: Why do sea turtles eat plastic bags?
options: They are very hungry in winter.
Plastic tastes good to them.
Their babies give the bags to them.
The bags look like their food.
questions.explanation: 第三段：「Sea turtles often eat plastic bags because the bags look like their favorite food.」把塑膠袋誤認成食物。餵小孩吃塑膠的是海鳥，不是海龜。

questions.question: How might plastic end up inside people?
options: People drink water from the ocean every day.
People eat fish that have eaten tiny pieces of plastic.
People often swim in the sea with plastic bags in their hands.
People use plastic cups to drink tea.
questions.explanation: 第三段：塑膠碎片「are eaten by small fish. Later, those fish may be eaten by bigger fish, and even by people.」人吃了吃過塑膠的魚，塑膠就跑進人體，所以選 B。

questions.question: Why does the writer write the last paragraph?
options: To explain where sea turtles live
To tell a story about a beach trip
To give students ways to help
To show how plastic is made
questions.explanation: 最後一段一開始就說「Students can help, too.」，接著列出自備杯子、不用吸管等做法，目的是告訴學生可以怎麼幫忙。

title: Robots and Jobs
grammar: 比較級與最高級、關係子句、not only … but also、if 條件句

blocks.x: Robots and computers are becoming smarter every year. In some factories, robots build cars all day and night without getting tired. In some restaurants, you can order food on a screen, and a machine may even bring it to your table. Many people are asking, "Will robots take away our jobs in the future?"

It is true that machines are good at some kinds of work. They are best at jobs that repeat the same steps again and again, such as checking products, moving boxes, or doing simple math. They are faster than people at these jobs, and they seldom make mistakes.

However, there are many jobs that still need people. A nurse not only gives medicine but also makes worried sick people feel better. A teacher can tell when a student is sad and needs help. Artists and writers come up with new ideas that no one has thought of before. Jobs like these need a kind heart, new ideas, and good speaking skills, which machines are not good at.

So what should students learn today? First, learn to work well with others, because most jobs need people to work together. Second, keep asking questions and try to solve problems in new ways. Third, do not be afraid of computers. Learn how to use them as helpful tools. If you have these skills, robots will be your friends, not your enemies.

questions.question: What is the reading mainly about?
options: What machines can do and what skills people need
How to build a robot in a car factory
Why nurses are more important than teachers
How to order food on a screen in a restaurant
questions.explanation: 第二段說機器擅長的工作，第三段說仍需要人的工作，第四段說學生該學的能力，所以選 A。

questions.question: According to the reading, which job are machines good at?
options: Helping sad students
Thinking of new ideas
Taking care of sick people
Moving boxes
questions.explanation: 第二段：機器最擅長重複的工作，「such as checking products, moving boxes, or doing simple math」。A、B、C 都是第三段說仍需要人做的事。

questions.question: What does “repeat” mean in the second paragraph?
options: To stop doing something
To do something again
To forget something
To change something
questions.explanation: 「jobs that repeat the same steps again and again」後面的 again and again 提示了意思：一再「重複」做同樣的步驟。

questions.question: Why will nurses probably still be needed in the future?
options: Robots are not able to carry medicine.
Nurses can work faster than machines.
Nurses can make worried sick people feel better.
Hospitals do not have enough money to buy robots.
questions.explanation: 第三段：「A nurse not only gives medicine but also makes worried sick people feel better.」這種關心人的能力機器做不到。文中說機器比人快，所以 B 錯。

questions.question: Which is NOT a skill that the writer tells students to learn?
options: Working well with others
Solving problems in new ways
Using computers as tools
Doing the same steps all day
questions.explanation: 第四段建議的三項是：與人合作、用新方法解決問題、把電腦當工具。一直重複同樣的步驟是機器擅長的事，不是作者要學生學的能力。

title: Phones at School?
grammar: 被動語態、現在完成式、unless/if 子句、關係子句

blocks.x: Text A: Kevin's Opinion

I think students should be allowed to bring phones to school. First, phones help keep us safe. When my bus is late or I feel sick, I can call my parents right away. Second, phones can be great learning tools. We can look up new words, find information for projects, and take photos of notes on the board. Of course, there should be rules. Phones should stay in our bags during class unless the teacher says we can use them.
Text B: Amy's Opinion

I don't agree that phones should be allowed at school. Many students are not able to stop checking their messages, even in class. Phones also keep us from talking to each other. At lunch, I often see classmates sitting together but looking only at their screens. If parents need to reach us, they can call the school office. In my opinion, school should be a place where we focus on learning and friends.

blocks.title: Class 9-3 Phone Survey
rows: Do you bring a phone to school?
Have you used your phone in class without asking?
Do you want phones at school?

questions.question: What does Kevin say about phones during class?
options: Students can use them at any time.
They should stay in bags unless the teacher allows it.
Teachers should keep all phones in the school office.
Students should only use them to call parents.
questions.explanation: Text A 最後一句：「Phones should stay in our bags during class unless the teacher says we can use them.」

questions.question: What do BOTH Kevin and Amy talk about?
options: Using phones to look up new words
Playing games on phones with classmates at lunch
How students and parents can call each other
Taking photos of notes on the board
questions.explanation: Kevin 說「I can call my parents right away」；Amy 說「If parents need to reach us, they can call the school office.」兩人都提到學生和家長的聯絡。A、D 只有 Kevin 提到；B 兩人都沒說。

questions.question: How many students in the survey do NOT bring a phone to school?
questions.explanation: 調查表第一題「Do you bring a phone to school?」回答 No 的有 4 人。9 是不想開放手機的人數，12 是上課偷用手機的人數。

questions.question: Which survey result would Amy most likely use to support her opinion?
options: 26 students bring phones to school.
21 students want phones at school.
18 students have never used phones in class without asking.
12 students have used phones in class without asking.
questions.explanation: Amy 反對的理由之一是「Many students are not able to stop checking their messages, even in class.」調查中有 12 人上課沒問過老師就用手機，最能支持她的看法。B 想要手機的人多，反而對 Kevin 有利。

questions.question: What does “reach” mean in “If parents need to reach us”?
options: To call or talk to someone
To walk to a place
To hit something with your hand
To give money to someone
questions.explanation: 「If parents need to reach us, they can call the school office.」後半句說可以打電話到學校辦公室，可知 reach 在這裡是「聯絡到」某人。

title: Which Train Should We Take?
grammar: 不定詞、because/so 子句、數字與價格、比較級

blocks.x: Text A: Mei's Message

Our family is planning a day trip to Hualien next Saturday. There are four of us: Dad, Mom, my little brother Leo, and me. We will leave from Taipei Station in the morning. Dad says we should not leave before 07:00, because it is hard for Leo to get up that early. We also want to get to Hualien before 11:00, so we can have lunch at a popular noodle shop near the station. We can spend at most $1,600 on train tickets for the whole family, one way. Leo is eight, so he pays half price. I am fourteen, so I pay the full price. Mom often feels sick on buses, so we will take the train. Which train should we take?
Text B: Taipei to Hualien Trains (Saturday)

blocks.title: Taipei to Hualien
items: Children under 12 pay half price.
Buy your tickets at least one day before you travel.

questions.question: Why will Mei's family take the train?
options: The train is cheaper than the bus.
Mom often feels sick on buses.
Leo has never taken a train before.
There are no buses on Saturday.
questions.explanation: Text A：「Mom often feels sick on buses, so we will take the train.」文中沒有比較火車和公車的價錢。

questions.question: Which train should Mei's family take?
options: Express 117
Local 205
Fast 223
Express 101
questions.explanation: 條件有三：07:00 以後出發、11:00 前到、四人車票不超過 $1,600。Express 101 06:30 出發太早；Local 205 11:25 才到；Express 117 時間可以，但 3×480＋240＝$1,680 超過預算；Fast 223 08:20 出發、10:50 到，3×360＋180＝$1,260，全部符合。

questions.question: How much will the four tickets on Fast 223 cost?
If the family took Express 117, how much more than $1,600 would they pay?
What does “at most” mean in “We can spend at most $1,600”?
options: At least, maybe more
Only on the first day
Not more than
For each person
questions.explanation: Mei 說全家單程車票「at most $1,600」，也就是最多只能花 $1,600，不能超過，所以選 C。

title: My Favorite Anime: Frieren
zh: 我為什麼喜歡《葬送的芙莉蓮》
grammar: 現在簡單式、過去簡單式、because／so

blocks.x: My Favorite Anime: Frieren
This year, my favorite anime is a Japanese story called Frieren. Frieren is an elf, and she can use magic. She lives much longer than people do.

Long ago, Frieren and her friends went on a long trip together, and they beat a strong and bad king. One of her friends was a hero named Himmel. For Frieren, the trip was only a very short time in her long life. Many years later, Himmel dies. Frieren feels sad because she never really knew him well. So she starts a new trip to learn more about people.

This story makes me think about my grandpa and grandma. They live in Tainan, and I only visit them two times a year. Before, I often played games on my phone during my visits. Now I put my phone away. I listen to Grandpa's stories and help Grandma cook dinner.
Our time with family and friends is not as long as we think, so don't wait. Who will you spend time with today?

questions.question: What is the writing mainly about?
options: How to draw pictures of an elf
Why the writer stopped playing games
What the writer learned about time from a story
A long trip the writer took with friends
questions.explanation: 作者先介紹 Frieren 的故事，再說「This story makes me think about my grandpa and grandma.」最後提醒「Our time with family and friends is not as long as we think」，重點是從故事中學到要珍惜和家人朋友相處的時間，所以選 C。B 只是其中一個細節。

questions.question: Why does Frieren start a new trip?
options: She wants to learn more about people.
She wants to find Himmel's home.
She wants to fight the bad king again.
She wants to visit the writer's family.
questions.explanation: 第二段寫「So she starts a new trip to learn more about people.」所以選 A。打敗國王是很久以前的旅程，不是新旅程的原因。

questions.question: What does the writer do now when he or she visits Grandpa and Grandma?
options: Plays games on the phone
Watches the story with Grandpa
Tells Grandma about magic
Helps Grandma cook dinner
questions.explanation: 第三段寫「Now I put my phone away. I listen to Grandpa's stories and help Grandma cook dinner.」所以選 D。A 是作者以前（Before）做的事。

questions.question: Why was the trip only a short time for Frieren?
options: Because the trip was only one day long
Because she lives much longer than people
Because she did not like her friends
Because she went home before the others
questions.explanation: 第一段寫「She lives much longer than people do.」第二段說「For Frieren, the trip was only a very short time in her long life.」她的生命很長，所以這段旅程對她來說很短，選 B。

title: Short but Not Afraid
grammar: 過去簡單式、but／so

blocks.x: I am the shortest boy in my class. When I started junior high, I wanted to join the volleyball club, but I was afraid. "Volleyball is only for tall people," I thought.

Then my cousin showed me a Japanese anime called Haikyu. The main character, Hinata, is short, too, but he loves volleyball. He can jump very high, and he works hard with his team. The next day, I went to the volleyball club.

Practice was not easy. We ran every morning at 07:00, and after school we practiced until 18:00. My legs hurt, and I often fell down. But my coach told me, "It is OK to be short. Just be fast and jump high." So every night I practiced jumping at home.
Three months later, we had a game with another school. Near the end, the ball came to me. I jumped high and hit it hard. We got the point! We lost the game, but my team cheered for me.
I am still short, but now I am not afraid.

questions.question: Why was the writer afraid to join the volleyball club at first?
options: He could not run fast.
He thought he was too short.
He did not have time after school.
His cousin did not like volleyball.
questions.explanation: 第一段寫「I am the shortest boy in my class.」又寫他心想「Volleyball is only for tall people」，他覺得自己太矮，所以選 B。

questions.question: When did practice end after school?
questions.explanation: 第三段寫「after school we practiced until 18:00」，所以選 D。07:00 是早上跑步的時間。

questions.question: How does the writer feel at the end of the story?
options: Brave and happy
Sad because his team lost
Angry with his coach
Tired of volleyball
questions.explanation: 球隊雖然輸了，但「my team cheered for me」，最後一句說「now I am not afraid」，可知他變得勇敢又開心，所以選 A。B：文中沒有說他因為輸球難過。

questions.question: What does "it" in "hit it hard" mean?
options: The game
The team
The ball
The point
questions.explanation: 前一句是「the ball came to me」，接著「I jumped high and hit it hard.」it 指的是球（the ball），所以選 C。

title: Movie Time!
grammar: 未來式、How about／Let's 提議、數字與時間

lines.x: Hi, everyone! The new Detective Conan movie is out. Let's see it this Saturday!
Yes! There are shows at 13:30, 16:00, and 19:10.
I have an English class until 15:00 on Saturday.
Then 13:30 is too early for Ivy. How about 16:00?
Good. 19:10 is too late for me. The movie is about two hours long, and my mom wants me home before 21:00.
OK, let's go at 16:00. How much are the tickets?
$320 for adults, but students only pay $260. Don't forget your student card!
Great. Where should we meet?
The movie theater is next to the MRT station. Let's meet at Exit 2 at 15:30.
My English class is near the station, so I can walk there in ten minutes.
Who will buy the tickets?
I can buy them on the Internet tonight. Please give me the money on Saturday.

questions.question: What time will the friends see the movie?
questions.explanation: 「我」提議「How about 16:00?」Jenny 回答「OK, let's go at 16:00.」所以選 D。15:30 是集合時間，13:30 和 19:10 分別對 Ivy 和 Leo 不方便。

questions.question: The four friends are all students. How much will they pay for the tickets in all?
questions.explanation: 對話寫「students only pay $260」，四個人都是學生，260 × 4 = $1,040，所以選 C。$1,280 是用全票 $320 算的。

questions.question: Why doesn't Leo want to see the 19:10 show?
options: He has an English class.
He cannot get home before 21:00.
The tickets are too expensive.
The theater is too far away.
questions.explanation: Leo 說「The movie is about two hours long, and my mom wants me home before 21:00.」19:10 開始的電影大約 21:10 才結束，他來不及在 21:00 前到家，所以選 B。A 是 Ivy 的情況。

questions.question: What does "them" in "I can buy them on the Internet" mean?
options: The movie tickets
The student cards
The English classes
The friends
questions.explanation: Jenny 問「Who will buy the tickets?」「我」回答「I can buy them on the Internet tonight.」them 指的是電影票，所以選 A。

title: Taipei Comic and Anime Fun Fair
grammar: 數字與價格、祈使句

blocks.title: Taipei Comic and Anime Fun Fair
items: Children under 6 can come in for free.
Ticket for all three days: $500 (students: $400)
Cosplay is welcome! Please change your clothes in the dressing room, not in the bathroom.
Do not bring food or drinks into the hall. You can eat in the food area outside.
Ask first before you take photos of people in cosplay.

questions.question: Mr. Chen and his son, a 14-year-old student, go to the fair on Saturday. How much do they pay?
questions.explanation: 表格中星期六成人票 $250、學生票 $200，250 + 200 = $450，所以選 A。$350 是用星期五的票價算的。

questions.question: On which day is the fair open for the longest time?
options: Friday
Saturday
Sunday
It is the same every day.

questions.question: What should people do before they take photos of people in cosplay?
options: Buy a ticket for all three days
Go to the dressing room
Eat in the food area
Ask the people first
questions.explanation: 海報寫「Ask first before you take photos of people in cosplay.」拍照前要先詢問對方，所以選 D。

questions.question: Amy is a student. She wants to go on all three days. How much money can she save with the ticket for all three days?
questions.explanation: 分開買學生票：150 + 200 + 200 = $550。海報寫「Ticket for all three days: $500 (students: $400)」，學生買三日票只要 $400，550 − 400 = $150，所以選 C。

title: Plants: Medicine or Danger?
grammar: 現在簡單式、祈使句、but／so

blocks.x: Have you seen the anime The Apothecary Diaries? Its main character, Maomao, is a young woman. The man who raised her taught her a lot about medicine and plants. She works in a palace and uses what she knows to help people and solve problems.
In real life, many plants are good for us. Some people drink hot tea made from plants when they have a cold, and some medicines also come from plants and flowers.
But some plants are dangerous. A few of them look like the vegetables we eat every day, but they can make people very sick. Even a small bite can hurt your stomach or your heart.

Maomao studied plants for many years, but most of us did not. So remember these rules. Never eat or taste a plant you don't know. Don't pick plants in the mountains for food. If you feel sick after you eat something, see a doctor right away. And if you want to use plants as medicine, ask a doctor first.
Anime can be fun to watch, but in real life, be careful and stay safe!

questions.question: What does the writer want us to learn?
options: How to make tea from flowers
How to get a job in a palace
Not to eat plants we don't know
Why we should watch more anime
questions.explanation: 文章後半提醒「Never eat or taste a plant you don't know.」最後說「in real life, be careful and stay safe!」作者想讓讀者知道不要亂吃不認識的植物，所以選 C。

questions.question: Who taught Maomao about medicine and plants?
options: The man who raised her
Her mother
A doctor
A teacher at school
questions.explanation: 第一段寫「The man who raised her taught her a lot about medicine and plants.」（在故事裡，教她的是扶養她長大的養父）所以選 A。

questions.question: What does "dangerous" mean in "some plants are dangerous"?
options: Very cheap
Very good to eat
Easy to find
Able to hurt people
questions.explanation: 「But some plants are dangerous.」後面接著說「they can make people very sick. Even a small bite can hurt your stomach or your heart.」可知 dangerous 是「會傷害人的、危險的」，所以選 D。

questions.question: What should you do if you feel sick after you eat something?
options: Drink some hot tea
See a doctor right away
Go to the mountains
Eat some vegetables
questions.explanation: 第四段寫「If you feel sick after you eat something, see a doctor right away.」所以選 B。

title: A Thousand Years and Ten Years
zh: 一千年與十年：《葬送的芙莉蓮》與時間
grammar: 現在完成式、比較級、關係子句、although/if 子句、as if

blocks.x: Have you ever felt that a summer vacation went by too fast, but one math class seemed to last all day? Time can feel long or short. A Japanese manga that was later made into an anime, Frieren, asks us to think about time in a special way.

Frieren is an elf who can use magic. Elves live much longer than humans, and Frieren has already lived for more than a thousand years. Long ago, she traveled with a hero named Himmel and his friends, and together they won against the Demon King. Their trip took about ten years. For Himmel and the others, those ten years were a big part of their lives. For Frieren, they were only a short time.

Years later, Himmel dies. Only then does Frieren realize that she never really tried to know him well, and she feels sorry about it. So she starts a new trip to understand people better. This time, she travels with her student Fern and a young fighter named Stark.

What can we learn from this story? Most of us will not live for a thousand years, but we often act as if we have all the time in the world. We say, "I will call Grandma next week," or "I can talk to my friend later." The story reminds us that the time we have with the people we care about is shorter than we think. If we wait too long, we may lose the chance.

Although Frieren has missed many chances, she shows that it is never too late to begin. She is slowly learning to see the value of small moments, like a walk, a meal, or a talk with a friend. Maybe that is a lesson for all of us.

questions.question: What is the reading mainly about?
options: How elves use magic to live for a long time
How a story about an elf makes us think about time with people we love
Why a trip of ten years is too long for most people
How Himmel and his friends won against the Demon King
questions.explanation: 文章從芙莉蓮對時間的感受談起，第四、五段說明故事提醒我們：「the time we have with the people we care about is shorter than we think」，所以選 B。A、D 只是文中的小細節；C 文中沒有這樣說。

questions.question: Why did the ten years feel short to Frieren?
options: She was busy using magic every day.
She did not like Himmel and his friends.
She was much younger than Himmel.
She has lived for more than a thousand years.
questions.explanation: 第二段：「Frieren has already lived for more than a thousand years.」對活了一千多年的她來說，十年「only a short time」，所以選 D。

questions.question: Why does Frieren start a new trip after Himmel dies?
options: She wishes she had tried to know Himmel and other people better.
She wants to find a new hero to travel with.
She needs to win against the Demon King again.
She wants to teach Fern more magic in a new place.
questions.explanation: 第三段：「she never really tried to know him well, and she feels sorry about it. So she starts a new trip to understand people better.」她後悔沒有好好認識 Himmel，所以出發去了解人，選 A。

questions.question: What does "we act as if we have all the time in the world" mean?
options: We always arrive on time.
We travel around the world.
We think we can do things later, so we wait.
We spend too much time studying.
questions.explanation: 後面舉例「I will call Grandma next week」「I can talk to my friend later」，都是覺得以後還有時間、先拖著不做，所以選 C。

questions.question: Why does the writer give the examples of calling Grandma and talking to a friend?
options: To show that people often put off spending time with others
To tell people how to use the phone well
To show that Frieren has a grandma and many friends
To explain why the anime is popular
questions.explanation: 第四段用「I will call Grandma next week」等例子，說明我們常以為還有時間而把陪伴別人往後延，接著說「If we wait too long, we may lose the chance.」所以選 A。

title: Volleyball, Haikyu, and Teamwork
zh: 從《排球少年》看團隊合作
grammar: 關係子句、被動語態、比較級、動名詞、when 子句

blocks.x: In volleyball, no player can win alone. Each player on the court has a different job. The Japanese anime called Haikyu, which is based on a popular manga, shows this very clearly.

The ball must not touch the floor on your side. When the other team hits the ball over the net, one player first keeps it up in the air. Then another player sets the ball. This means passing it up high near the net. After that, a hitter jumps and hits the ball down hard to the other side. Many teams also have a special player who stays at the back. This player is very good at keeping the ball up after the other team's strong hits.

In Haikyu, Shoyo Hinata is much shorter than most volleyball players, but he can jump very high. Tobio Kageyama is a talented player who is excellent at setting the ball. They both play for Karasuno High School. A hitter needs a good set, and even the best set is not helpful if no one is there to hit it. Together, the two boys are much stronger than either one alone.

The story also teaches that every player is good at something different. A short player may not be the best at stopping tall players, but he may be quick. A quiet player may be good at watching the game carefully. A good team does not ask everyone to be the same. It finds where each person can help the most.

This idea is not only true in sports. In a class project, one student may be good at drawing, another at speaking, and another at finding information. When we work together and use what each person does best, we can do more than we could do alone.

questions.question: What does the player who sets the ball do?
options: Stays at the back and stops hard hits
Hits the ball down hard to the other side
Passes the ball up high near the net
Watches the game and tells others what to do
questions.explanation: 第二段：「another player sets the ball. This means passing it up high near the net.」所以選 C。B 是 hitter 的工作，A 是待在後方的特別球員。

questions.question: Which is true about Hinata?
options: He is shorter than most players, but he can jump very high.
He is the best player at setting the ball.
He is a special player who stays at the back.
He plays for a different school from Kageyama.
questions.explanation: 第三段：「Shoyo Hinata is much shorter than most volleyball players, but he can jump very high.」B 是 Kageyama；D 錯，兩人「both play for Karasuno High School」。

questions.question: What does "It" mean in "It finds where each person can help the most"?
options: A short player
The game
A quiet player
A good team
questions.explanation: 前一句是「A good team does not ask everyone to be the same.」接著「It finds where each person can help the most.」It 指的是 a good team，所以選 D。

questions.question: Which sentence would the writer most likely agree with?
